Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE very high-resolution LANDSCAPE modeling construction/detail sheet for the SAME exact Rail Arena character. Image 1 is the approved original identity/style authority. Image 2 is the eight-view turnaround and locked costume geometry authority; match its exact character, face, hair, armor, colors and accessories. This is additional coverage of the same design, NEVER a redesign. Do NOT copy the crude existing game models.
Use a clean 4-column by 3-row grid, twelve equally generous cards, warm light gray neutral background, restrained thin dividers, soft neutral studio light, polished high-detail low-poly game art with confident planar sculpture. Fill cells well, keep all details uncropped and legible. Orthographic-style technical views with no wide-angle distortion. Only the brief panel labels below; no invented measurement values, no new logos, no weapons, no detached armor floating over the body.
Top row, four matching-scale head/neck close-ups, exact same person: HEAD FRONT; HEAD RIGHT (nose toward RIGHT edge); HEAD LEFT (nose LEFT); HEAD BACK. Show the complete hair volume, ears and jaw/collar transition, serious neutral expression. Maintain hair part and asymmetry without mirroring identity.
Middle row four cards: HEAD TOP (true overhead crown and hair flow); BODY TOP (true downward orthographic view of the complete same neutral A-pose body, showing shoulder/forearm/chest/back depth relationships); BODY BOTTOM (true upward orthographic underside of same A-pose, showing both boot soles, palms and underside armor; not a second frontal pose); RIGHT GLOVE (two orthographic close-ups side by side of the exact same right glove, BACK OF HAND and PALM, naturally straight spread fingers, exactly five fingers each, fingerless tips, cuff and knuckle plates consistent).
Bottom row four cards: RIGHT BOOT (outer and inner profile side by side, same right foot equipment, accurate ankle closures); BOOT TOP / SOLE (true top and true underside of that same boot side by side, distinct labeled silhouettes and believable matching tread); TORSO FRONT / BACK (close-ups of both sides of the exact fitted chest shell, collar and scapular plates, retain all straps/seams); BELT / HIP PANELS (front and back waist-to-mid-thigh views with belt buckle, pouches and exact anatomical-side asymmetries).
Every card must agree with Image 2. New hidden surfaces must be a restrained physically plausible continuation of the existing costume, not additional accessories. In the glove/boot pairs keep equipment on the same anatomical limb; never substitute another costume or use a mirrored asymmetric part. Tread, glove palm and overhead construction are new design extensions for modeling and should look manufacturable within this stylized game design. Preserve original adult proportions and facial appeal.
